name: askk-v86-vm
description: Builds the v86 x86 VM serial-console bundle (assets/v86_vm.js) consumed by the ASKK VM page. Run `bun install && bun run build` after editing entry.js or bumping deps, then commit the regenerated asset and the v86 runtime blobs (v86_vm.wasm, v86_bios.bin, v86_vgabios.bin) in assets/. The build goes through build.mjs because libv86 has a dead Node-only `require("perf_hooks")` branch that the browser bundle must stub out.
